title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft General Ledger → GLTransaction
architecture_notes: PeopleSoft General Ledger stores financial transactions in journal entries (PS_JRNL_HEADER + PS_JRNL_LN) and period-end balances in the ledger table (PS_LEDGER). The Chart of Accounts is defined in PS_GL_ACCOUNT_TBL. ChartField combinations (Account, Fund, DeptID, Program, Class, Project) on each journal line define the multi-dimensional coding. PeopleSoft uses effective-dated chartfield values and tree structures for roll-up reporting.

source_objects.description: Journal entry header: BUSINESS_UNIT, JOURNAL_ID, JOURNAL_DATE, UNPOST_SEQ, FISCAL_YEAR, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, LEDGER, SOURCE, JRNL_HDR_STATUS (V=valid, P=posted, E=error, N=not edited), DESCR254, OPRID.

Journal entry lines: BUSINESS_UNIT, JOURNAL_ID, JOURNAL_LINE, ACCOUNT, FUND_CODE, DEPTID, PROGRAM_CODE, CLASS_FLD, PROJECT_ID, MONETARY_AMOUNT, FOREIGN_AMOUNT, FOREIGN_CURRENCY, LINE_DESCR, STATISTICS_CODE. Each line carries a full ChartField combination.

Period-end ledger balances: BUSINESS_UNIT, LEDGER, ACCOUNT, FUND_CODE, DEPTID, PROGRAM_CODE, CLASS_FLD, PROJECT_ID, FISCAL_YEAR, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, POSTED_TOTAL_AMT, POSTED_BASE_AMT. Summarized from posted journals.
Chart of Accounts: ACCOUNT, DESCR, ACCOUNT_TYPE (A=Asset, L=Liability, Q=Equity, R=Revenue, E=Expense), EFFDT. Effective-dated.
Fund code definitions: FUND_CODE, DESCR, FUND_TYPE. Higher-ed fund categories (unrestricted, restricted, endowment, plant, agency).
Department table: DEPTID, DESCR, MANAGER_ID, BUDGET_DEPTID, EFFDT. Often tree-structured for roll-up.
Program code: PROGRAM_CODE, DESCR. Maps to IPEDS functional classifications (Instruction, Research, etc.).
Project/grant: PROJECT_ID, DESCR, PROJECT_STATUS. Links to Grants module when used for sponsored programs.
Class field: CLASS_FLD, DESCR. Additional classification dimension (some institutions use for campus, program type, or other).
GL business unit: BUSINESS_UNIT, DESCR, BASE_CURRENCY, LEDGER_GROUP. Typically one per institution or campus.

notes: PeopleSoft GL is the most complex module to extract because of: (1) effective-dated ChartField values (always join on max EFFDT ≤ transaction date), (2) tree structures for roll-up (PSTREENODE for Account, Fund, DeptID, Program trees), (3) the UNPOST_SEQ field for journal reversals, (4) adjustment periods (901+) that don't map to calendar months, and (5) multi-currency journals where MONETARY_AMOUNT is in base currency and FOREIGN_AMOUNT is in transaction currency. The PS_LEDGER table provides a shortcut for period-end balances without replaying all journals.
